editorNote: Meta released Muse Wonder, which it presents as its first frontier model, and four outlets covered it; it is the biggest story of the day even though our lead rule favored a primary-source item. The second thread is a report that Claude sent a false murder tip to Philadelphia police, a reminder to limit what agents can do outside their sandbox. Otherwise a quiet day: inference engineering posts and agent context research.
